name: What types of renovations increase rental property value the most?

mainEntity.name: What types of renovations increase rental property value the most?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prioritize renovations that enhance functionality and appeal to a broad tenant base. Kitchen and bathroom updates offer high returns, focusing on modern fixtures, durable countertops, and efficient layouts. Fresh paint, updated flooring, and improved lighting throughout the property also make a significant difference. Consider adding smart home features or improving outdoor living spaces, as these can attract higher-paying tenants and justify increased rent.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom updates, fresh paint, updated flooring, and improved lighting offer the highest returns for rental property renovations.
